items.text: AI courses for commerce and arts students should focus on using AI tools well in their own fields, such as finance, marketing, writing, research and design, with some data literacy and judgement about errors and ethics, rather than on advanced mathematics or coding unless the student chooses that path.
Start with free tool use in your own subject, learn to check AI output, add spreadsheet and data basics and build a small project that saves time in a real task.
Check what you will build, who teaches and whether the content stays current before paying.
